# Autonomous Repair
Recoverable technical failure is not a stopping condition. Diagnose, repair the canonical cause, reverify affected evidence and resume the mission. Stop only at COMPLETE or a proven BLOCKED_OWNER, BLOCKED_ACCESS, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, BLOCKED_SAFETY or BLOCKED_AUTHORITY boundary. Do not repeatedly ask the user to continue ordinary engineering work. Preserve scope and concurrency protections throughout retries.
